verdict.rationale:
Chroma ships as an embeddable Python/JS client and a self-hostable server/CLI (run locally, self-host, or Chroma Cloud), which supports headless, scriptable use in automation pipelines, and the GitHub quick-start shows a non-interactive DB spin-up. However, there is no explicit CI/automation guide, Docker-in-CI example, or documented headless test harness pattern.
missing for 10: explicit CI pipeline example/docs, headless/no-GUI confirmation beyond CLI mention, automated testing guidance.
